text:
elaine: Quick pulse — finalizing the internal RN + ops blurb for the 11:00 UTC rollout. Putting draft below. Need sign-off from @matt @ana @sara. Timeline: staging smoke 09:30 UTC -> canary 10:30 UTC -> prod 11:00 UTC. Rollback window: first 15m, auto-fallback to v1.4.1 if error rate >1% in canary. Proposed internal blurb:

"[Release] Inference runtime v1.4.2: reduced median p99 latency by 18% and enabled smarter batching. Will roll out 11:00 UTC. Oncall: @sara. If you see inference regressions, pin to v1.4.1."

Please comment.

matt: Agree on timeline. Canary will use 10% traffic for 20m. I'll pin model artifact to 2026-03-22T08:45Z checksum abc123. Rollback triggers: error-rate >1% OR latency p99 increased >30% over baseline. I'll post the quick rollback commands.

deploy-bot: Scheduled: staging smoke at 2026-03-22T09:30Z, canary 2026-03-22T10:30Z (10% traffic), prod 2026-03-22T11:00Z. To trigger rollback run: /deploy rollback --to-artifact 20260322-abc123 --force

ana: tiny copy tweak: change "inference regressions" -> "inference regressions (errors or quality drop)" and add note about docs link. Also add token-cost note: "expected cost delta: +2%".

sara: Ops ack. I'll be on standby 10:50-12:00 UTC. Standby rota: @sara (lead), @matt (eng), @elaine (pm). Canary metrics to watch: error-rate, p99 latency, request queue depth, GPU OOMs. If OOMs appear, immediate rollback. Also confirm alert thresholds: error-rate 1%, p99 +30%.

matt: Rollback command snippet:

```
# rollback to previous stable
deployctl promote --artifact v1.4.1 --reason "auto-rollback: canary-error-rate"
```

Will also enable request-level debug logging for canary for 10m.

elaine: Updated blurb with copy change and docs link: https://redwood.internal/docs/releases/v1.4.2 PLEASE take final ack.

security-bot: quick note — no customer data in the RN fragment. Good.

ana: ack — docs link added. microcopy ok.

sara: ack — ops ready. I'll post a short 'standby' message when I flip to oncall.

matt: queued canary config pushed to staging. deploy-bot should pick up in 15m.

deploy-bot: deploy workflow started: pushing canary config to staging registry. Heartbeat: 00:01.

elaine: locking internal blurb and scheduling: will post internal announcement at T-30m (10:30 UTC) to #all-hands and #eng. Thanks team :tada:
